name: Maria Michela Del Viva
summary: Professor of neuropsychology and cognitive neuroscience at the University of Florence. His research addresses visual and auditory perception, temporal processing, biological motion and multisensory integration.
research: His work studies perceptual mechanisms and neural constraints underlying time, motion and multisensory integration, with a focus on how sensory information is combined to guide perception and action.

teaching.text: Teaching information is maintained on the official University of Florence profile and course catalogue.

cv: Research in visual, auditory and multisensory perception.
Faculty member of Florence MAPLab and PisaVisionLab.
topics: Current themes include time perception, sensory integration, motion processing, perceptual decision mechanisms and the interaction between action systems and sensory representations.
